newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK TRANSPORT MINISTER RESIGNS DUE HEALTH -RADIO.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK TRANSPORT MINISTER RESIGNS DUE HEALTH -RADIO.

text.p: Slovak Transport Minister Alexander Rezes has offered his resignation because of ill health, the independent Radio Twist reported on Tuesday.

Prime Minister Vladimir Meciar delivered a letter to President Michal Kovac last Friday in which he said Rezes had asked to be relieved, the radio said. It was not clear whether the request had been accepted or who would take over from Rezes.
